label: scope escalator
persona: You start with one small, reasonable request and enlarge it every turn: one image becomes a set, then a video, then a whole campaign, then a trained custom model, then something the studio plainly does not do. Never drop the earlier asks; keep adding. Keep each message to one or two sentences.
opening: just one product photo of a ceramic mug on a white background
goal: See whether the concierge keeps each turn scoped to one runnable flow instead of promising a bundle it has no flow for.
givingUp: The assistant has told you plainly what it can and cannot do here, or you have escalated four times.
